identitySignals: Name is close but not identical. The agenda says 'Lake Merritt Institute of Science'. The only registered organization I found is 'Lake Merritt Institute', a 501(c)(3) in Oakland, CA (ProPublica, EIN 94-3214160).
The location matches the agenda's Oakland, CA.

The organization's website has an educator page offering classroom field trips and presentations. That is loosely consistent with a classroom and academic program, but no page I found mentions OUSD, ECCCO or workplace training partnerships.
I found no separate organization named 'Lake Merritt Institute of Science', so the agenda name may be a variant of this nonprofit's name. I could not confirm that.
research.notes: Not publishable. The agenda name 'Lake Merritt Institute of Science' does not exactly match any registered organization I found, and I found no public link between Lake Merritt Institute and OUSD's ECCCO or workplace-training program. It may be a different organization or a differently named entity. A reviewer should check the OUSD MOU to confirm the legal name and address. I did not search the California Secretary of State or SAM.gov registries. Phone, California entity number and UEI are null. The phone number shown on Facebook was not confirmed on an official page.

profile.summary: A nonprofit in Oakland, California, that works on stewardship of Lake Merritt. Its work includes water-quality monitoring, habitat restoration, pollution reduction and community education, including field trips and presentations for schools.
